title: Valorization of Sargassum spp. for bio-inspired synthesis of ZnO/Au nanocomposites used in SERS detection of trace herbicides
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00766F, Paper
J. Luis López-Miranda, Isaac Velázquez-Hernández, Gustavo A. Molina, Alberto Elizalde-Mata, Fabian Mares-Briones, Rodrigo Esparza, Noe Arjona, Miriam Estévez
The widespread use of herbicides like glyphosate and glufosinate requires the development of ultrasensitive, selective, and field-deployable sensors for their monitoring.
